subject: Exec brief + platform demo — VP/CIO attendance and backup plan
messages:
From: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@solara.co>
To: chloe_martin@redwood.com
Cc: Paul Singer <paul.singer@solara.co>
Date: 2028-07-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Exec brief + platform demo — interest in VP/CIO attendance

Hi Chloe,

Thanks for taking the time to connect last week. Solara is keen to see Redwood’s inference platform end-to-end. Our VP of Engineering (Sana Patel) and CIO (Diego Ruiz) would like an exec-level briefing followed by a 45-minute demo focused on:

- performance and latency guarantees for multi-region traffic
- security posture (VPC/private deployment options, KMS/HSM)
- predictable cost modeling for our batch and real-time workloads

Can you do a 45-minute slot that includes a 10–15 minute pre-brief for our execs (private Q&A) and a 30–35 minute walkthrough/demo? Preferred windows next week:

1) Tue Jul 25, 10:00–11:00 PT
2) Wed Jul 26, 14:00–15:00 PT
3) Thu Jul 27, 08:00–09:00 PT

If you can confirm availability and who from your side will be on the call (we need a single technical backup if the CIO has to step out), that would be great.

Also, we have an internal procurement milestone on Aug 7, so an early demo helps. I’m attaching a calendar stub with our internal conflicts so you can see constraints.

Thanks,
Tom
Tom Alvarez
Head of Platform Partnerships, Solara
Tom.Alvarez@solara.co
+1 (415) 555-0123

Attachment: solara_internal_conflicts.ics (calendar placeholders)
From: chloe_martin@redwood.com
To: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@solara.co>
Cc: marcus_lin@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: 2028-07-18T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Exec brief + platform demo — VP/CIO attendance and backup plan

Tom — thanks for the note and the context. We can absolutely run that format (10–15 min private exec pre-brief + 30–35 min demo + 5–10 min Q&A).

Availability: I can do Wed Jul 26, 14:00–15:00 PT (window 2) and Thu Jul 27, 08:00–09:00 PT (window 3). If you prefer Tue, we may need to shift slightly (I’m OOO the morning of the 25th).

Proposed attendees from our side:
- Chloe Martin — Account Executive (lead)
- Marcus Lin — Solutions Engineer (demo + tech backup)
- Laura Bennett — Customer Success (exec pre-brief and procurement alignment)

Two quick asks before we lock time:
1) Confirm final exec names (VP of Eng, CIO) and any additional stakeholders who need to be on the private pre-brief.
2) Flag any non-public data or compliance questions we should route to our Security team ahead of time (SOC 2, data residency specifics).

If the CIO might step out, Marcus will be the technical backup and can cover the runtime architecture + failover path. I’m looping Laura to help with procurement timing given your Aug 7 milestone.

I’ll hold Wed 14:00 PT tentatively; can you confirm by EOD tomorrow?

Best,
Chloe
Chloe Martin
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
chloe.martin@redwood.com

---
Note: Marcus can lead a 15-minute dry run with your engineers the day before the demo if helpful.
From: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@solara.co>
To: chloe_martin@redwood.com
Cc: Paul Singer <paul.singer@solara.co>
Date: 2028-07-18T16:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Exec brief + platform demo — VP/CIO attendance and backup plan

Chloe — appreciated. Quick update: Sana (VP Eng) is confirmed for Wed 26 at 14:00 PT. Diego (CIO) has a potential conflict that day — there’s a board prep call that might overlap. If Diego can’t make the 14:00 slot, we want to keep the demo but have the CIO join the private pre-brief and delegate the demo to the VP.

So the ask: if Diego can only do the pre-brief at 14:00 and needs to drop before the demo, can Marcus act as the CTO/CIO proxy for the technical deep-dive and leave the private questions for the pre-brief? That would keep us on track for procurement.

Also: we’d like the dry run on Tues Jul 25, 09:00 PT (our engineering team can join). Does that work for Marcus?

Paul — looping you to keep procurement timing visible.

Thanks,
Tom

From: chloe_martin@redwood.com
To: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@solara.co>
Cc: marcus_lin@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: 2028-07-19T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Exec brief + platform demo — VP/CIO attendance and backup plan

Tom — perfect, thanks for the update and for confirming Sana. Marking Wed Jul 26, 14:00–15:00 PT as confirmed for the public demo + 13:45–14:00 PT private exec pre-brief for Diego (if he’s available).

Action items and owners:
- Chloe Martin: send final invite and link to the event, include agenda and attendee list (today EOD).
- Marcus Lin: lead the demo and own the dry run on Tue Jul 25, 09:00 PT with Solara engineering (Marcus to confirm availability).
- Laura Bennett: share procurement collateral and a one-page pricing summary aligned to Solara’s expected throughput (Laura to send by Mon Jul 24).

Marcus — can you confirm you can run the 25th dry run at 09:00 PT? If not, propose an alternate morning window. Also please attach the internal demo checklist after the dry run.

Tom — attachments below: I’ve included a draft agenda and the pre-brief slide pack for your execs. If Diego can only join the pre-brief, we’ll make sure his questions are captured and sent after the demo.

Looking forward — we’ll send the calendar invite with attendee roles and the DocuSign proposal link after Laura’s pricing note.

Best,
Chloe Martin
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
chloe.martin@redwood.com

Attachments: demo-agenda-v2.pdf, prebrief-slide.odp
